name: SCORCH: Spatiotemporal Classification of Regional Compound Heatwaves
description: SCORCH identifies regionally extensive compound heatwaves in daily maximum temperature fields: local heatwaves at every grid cell, regionally extensive days, DBSCAN clusters of heatwave cells, PCA ellipses with temperature-weighted centroids, and compound events of four types. Includes the R scripts of the power-law and log-Gaussian Cox process models, a synthetic demo, tests and the study results for the Eastern Mediterranean and Middle East (1940-2025).
softwareRequirements: R packages spatstat.geom, spatstat.model, spatstat.explore, jsonlite, poweRlaw (models)
